autoPurchase.title: Auto-buy label when packing completes
autoPurchase.hint:
When ON: orders that finish the Pack stage automatically get a VNP label if ALL apply: the order was placed through the system (portal/CSV/API) with ship method express_us or economy_us; no customer-provided tracking; no existing shipment. Multi-item orders (same seller order ID) buy one label only after the last item is packed.
Failed purchases (bad address, empty wallet...) are only logged — packing is NOT blocked and there is NO automatic retry; buy manually via the "VNP shipment" button as before.
autoPurchase.weight: Default weight (gram) when order has none
autoPurchase.weightInvalid: Default weight must be greater than 0
